teams.detail: Jedd Fisch remains in a quiet recruiting period while calling plays himself after OC Jimmie Dougherty's February departure; 4-star WR commit Tre Moore has been turning heads at summer 7v7 events. Season opens with the Boeing Apple Cup vs. Washington State, Sunday, Sept. 6 (1 p.m. PT, NBC) at Husky Stadium.

Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding through the transfer portal after a 16-17 finish and Zoom Diallo's departure, landing Croatian forward Boris Tisma while continuing to pursue Rainier Beach's Jaylen Petty. Center Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft.

HBO dropped the trailer for 'Hard Knocks: Training Camp with the Seattle Seahawks' (premieres Aug. 11) as the defending Super Bowl champs opened camp; safety Nick Emmanwori was placed on the PUP list but a team source called it no major concern. NFL owners still expected to vote in August on the Khosla family's record $9.612 billion purchase.

Contract talks with free agent center Jalen Duren have reportedly hit a 'standstill' and could drag into August, even after Detroit freed cap space by sending Caris LeVert to Milwaukee for Taurean Prince and Gary Harris and re-signing Javonte Green for one year.

Seattle routed Cincinnati 8-0 Monday behind Cal Raleigh's sixth career grand slam and a three-hitter from George Kirby and the bullpen, improving to 51-50 and taking over first place in the AL West. Mariners close the series tonight, 9:40 p.m. PT at T-Mobile Park (Luis Castillo vs. Chase Burns).

headlines.headline: Pistons' contract talks with free agent center Jalen Duren reportedly at a 'standstill'
headlines.detail: ESPN's Ramona Shelburne reported that Detroit's negotiations with restricted free agent Jalen Duren have stalled and could stretch deep into August, even as Pistons officials continue to call re-signing him the offseason's top priority after acquiring Taurean Prince and Gary Harris from Milwaukee for Caris LeVert and re-signing Javonte Green to a one-year deal.

headlines.headline: Training camps open league-wide as Dolphins, Packers lock up defensive starters with new extensions
headlines.detail: All 32 NFL teams are set to report to training camp by July 28 as Miami signed LB Jordyn Brooks to a three-year, $51.3 million extension and Green Bay locked up DT Devonte Wyatt for three years and $57 million; Carolina's Taylor Moton will open camp on the reserve/NFI list after a lung blood clot diagnosis.

headlines.headline: SEC Media Days Day Two: Kirby Smart's Georgia takes the Tampa stage as the conference opens its first nine-game slate
headlines.detail: Georgia's Kirby Smart headlined Tuesday's session alongside Auburn's Alex Golesh, South Carolina's Shane Beamer and Vanderbilt's Clark Lea, with the SEC kicking off a nine-game schedule for the first time; Lane Kiffin's first appearance as LSU's coach and Arch Manning's Texas spotlight are still ahead later in the week.

headlines.headline: Michigan AD Warde Manuel to step down at year-end after months-long athletics department investigation
headlines.detail: Michigan announced Monday that AD Warde Manuel will step down at the end of the calendar year following an internal investigation into the athletics department, handing his successor the job of evaluating first-year men's basketball coach Mike Boynton after Dusty May's late-offseason exit to the NBA.
